content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NARIP Consultant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 14-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NARIP Consultant (Pathologist) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your bio-data for the NARIP Consultant (Pathologist) recruitment is 14th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the eligibility criteria for the Consultant (Pathologist) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree with at least 10 years of post-qualification experience in Pathology. Retired government employees in Pay Level-10 or above with 10 years of relevant experience are also eligible.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 40 years, and the maximum age limit is 69 years for the Consultant (Pathologist) position.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Consultant (Pathologist) role?
faq.answer: The selection process involves two stages: initial screening of the bio-data submitted by the candidates, followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Consultant (Pathologist) position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Consultant (Pathologist) post is Rs. 4000/- per visit, with a maximum of 10 visits allowed per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for the NARIP recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is to be done via email. Candidates need to send their bio-data and required documents to the official email address provided.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by the National Ayurveda Research Institute for Panchakarma (NARIP).

faq.question: Q9. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Consultant (Pathologist) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the National Ayurveda Research Institute for Panchakarma located?
faq.answer: The National Ayurveda Research Institute for Panchakarma (NARIP) is located in Cheruthuruthy, Kerala, with the pincode 679531.
